lists.title: EasyList
lists.source: Official EasyList GitHub repository (github.com/easylist/easylist), gh-pages branch, which holds the published lists. Pinned to a commit so the URL is immutable. Used instead of easylist.to, which has no versioned URLs and was unreachable from the build environment when this pipeline was set up.
